parameters.name: AssetAccountName
parameters.description: The logon name of the asset account for which you want to request O&M access.

parameters.name: AssetId
parameters.description:
The ID of the asset for which you want to request O&M access.
> You can call the [ListOperationDatabases](~~2758856~~) or [ListOperationHosts](~~2758857~~) operation to query this parameter.

parameters.name: EffectEndTime
parameters.description:
The end time of the validity period for the logon request. Unit: seconds. The value is a UNIX timestamp.
> The end time of the validity period must be later than the start time.

parameters.name: EffectStartTime
parameters.description: The start time of the validity period for the logon request. Unit: seconds. The value is a UNIX timestamp.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID of the bastion host.
> You can invoke the [DescribeInstances](~~153281~~) operation to query this parameter.

parameters.name: IsOneTimeEffect
parameters.description:
The number of logon times allowed. Valid values:
- **true**: Only one logon is allowed within the validity period.
- **false**: Unlimited logons are allowed within the validity period.

parameters.name: ProtocolName
parameters.description:
The name of the protocol for which you want to request O&M access. Valid values:
- SSH
- RDP
- MySQL
- PostgreSQL
- Oracle
- SQLServer

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the bastion host.
> For the mapping between region IDs and region names, see [Regions and zones](~~40654~~).
